item.description: Waneta Fugitt loved spending time with her loved ones. She will be deeply missed by her family, and friends. Read more: Waneta Armstrong Fugitt

item.title: New Walmart in Ocala seeking liquor permit as structure nears completion
item.description: As a new Walmart Neighborhood Market in southeast Ocala nears completion ahead of its scheduled opening, the retailer is seeking city approval to sell beer, wine, and liquor at its new location. Read more: New Walmart in Ocala seeking liquor permit as structure nears completion

item.title: Marina Pedraza
item.description: Marina Pedraza enjoyed gardening, caring for her animals, singing, attending mass at Blessed Trinity where she sang in the choir; she enjoyed poetry, and playing instruments. Read more: Marina Pedraza

item.title: Artist donating $9,500 ‘Flamingo’ sculpture to Ocala
item.description: A 9-foot-tall, 440-pound avian sculpture that was only supposed to be passing through Tuscawilla Park is now set to make Ocala its permanent home. Read more: Artist donating $9,500 ‘Flamingo’ sculpture to Ocala

item.title: William Bradford Marren
item.description: William Marren was a true Gator fan, he was active in the Quarterback Club. He had the Irish gift for gab and was a great storyteller. He loved the concert atmosphere, the sounds, and drumsticks. Read more: William Bradford Marren

item.title: Former Marion inmate asking to pay $16,000 in jail fees by volunteering at faith-based shelter that saved his life
item.description: A graduate of a local recovery program is asking Marion County officials to convert a civil restitution lien of more than $16,000 into community service, citing his commitment to volunteering and helping others at the same faith-based recovery shelter that helped him. Read more: Former Marion inmate asking to pay $16,000 in jail fees by volunteering at faith-based shelter that saved his life

item.title: Ocala woman accused of slitting boyfriend’s throat with kitchen knife
item.description: A 35-year-old Ocala woman is behind bars on an attempted murder charge after she was accused of slitting her boyfriend’s throat with a knife. Read more: Ocala woman accused of slitting boyfriend’s throat with kitchen knife

item.title: First full moon of the year in Ocala
item.description: This beautiful full moon in Ocala, photographed on Saturday, was the first of 2026. Thanks to Laura Buckley for sharing! Read more: First full moon of the year in Ocala
